meta.dataset: ShanghaiT2DM (Zhao et al., Scientific Data 2023), 100 people with type 2 diabetes, 109 recordings, CGM every 15 min
protocol: All choices (Kalman parameters, hyperparameters, conformal adjustment, personalisation, calibration, alert thresholds) were made with 5-fold patient-grouped cross-validation on the 80 development patients.
Early stopping used held-out development patients, never the fold being scored.
The 20 test patients were scored once with the frozen model; see results/TEST_LOCK.json.
Event thresholds are fixed by consensus (Battelino 2019): 70, 180 and 250 mg/dL, sustained >= 15 min.

models.label: Average of LightGBM and GRU (not deployed)

external.dataset: CGMacros v1.0.0 (Das et al., Scientific Data 2025), PhysioNet, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
notes: Frozen ShanghaiT2DM model; no refitting on CGMacros for the transfer test.
Missing inputs (medications, most labs, complications, meal grams) passed as missing.
Groups by HbA1c: <5.7% healthy, 5.7-6.4% prediabetes, >=6.5% T2D.
Wearable experiment is exploratory (45 participants); features use heart rate and Fitbit activity energy.
